prompt: This replay should rebuild the map from the log. A power cut can leave a half-written record at the very end. Tap the line that makes recovery lose data in that case.
explain: A torn tail shows up as `io.ErrUnexpectedEOF`. Returning `nil, err` throws away every record that was already recovered. A torn tail should end the replay with the map built so far; only genuine damage should be an error.
